definition: the act or an instance of kicking mutually.

definition: the medium sized , evergreen tree Diospyros peregrina (= D. embryopteris, = D/ glutenifera) of Ebenaceae family, the fruits of which contain tannin.
example_en: The fruits of the Diospyros peregrina tree contain tannin.

definition: the quality or fact of being famous.
example_en: That poet's fame had spread everywhere.

definition: a connection, tie or link between individuals of a group, members of a series, etc.
example: ಎರಡು ಊರುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಪೊಳಸು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was an old connection between the two villages.

definition: one who steals chicken; a chicken-lifter.
example_en: The people caught and beat that chicken-lifter.

definition: a person who follows something (as an art or science) only out of curiosity, intentness or interest or for pleasure(rather than as a profession or occupation); an amateur.
example: ಅವನು ಚಿತ್ರಕಲೆಯ ಹವ್ಯಾಸಿಯಾಗಿ ಬಿಡುವಿನ ವೇಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is a hobbyist in painting and draws in his spare time.

definition: a document evidencing the final agreement, arrangement or settlement.
example_en: Both parties signed the final agreement document.

definition: a village watchman or guard; a town policeman.
example: ತಱವಳ ರಾತ್ರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಊರ ಸುತ್ತ ಕಾವಲು ಕಾಯುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The village watchman keeps guard around the village at night.

definition: a future event.
example_en: The astrologer predicted that future event accurately.

definition: the supposed disembodied spirit of a dead person; a ghost; a spectre.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಬಂಗಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪೇತು ಸುತ್ತಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಜನರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say that a ghost wanders in the old bungalow.

definition: the leader of a group of merchants moving together, from one place to another, for purpose of buying and selling goods.
example_en: The caravan leader led the group of merchants.

definition: a heavy flow of stream.
example_en: After the rain, a heavy stream flowed.

definition: a woman who founds, establishes (something); a founder.
example_en: The founder of that school was an example to everyone.

definition: very tiny; minute; subtle.
example_en: His analysis contained many subtle points.

definition: slightly; in small quantity, number etc.
example_en: He received a slight amount of money.

definition: the main door of a palace or mansion.
example_en: The main door of the palace was very large.

definition: a small mirror that can be used by holding in the hand.
example_en: She had kept a small hand mirror in her bag.

definition: a room equipped for cooking in a large scale; a large kitchen.
example: ಮದುವೆ ಮನೆಯ ಬಾಣಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡುಗೆಯವರು ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In the wedding house's large kitchen, the cooks had been working since morning.

definition: one of the seven mother-goddesses.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಚವಡಿ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಪೂಜೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers offered worship to the goddess Cavaḍi.

definition: a kind of insect.
example: ಮಳೆಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಲುಗುಡಿತೆ ಎಂಬ ಕೀಟ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The insect called huluguditе is seen more often during the rainy season.

definition: the act of beating; battering.
example_en: The thief received a beating from the people.

definition: a long, almost cylindrical, percussion instrument that has leather membrane on both sides, which is very popular in Karnāṭaka system of music.
example_en: The jhayi instrument resounded at the music concert.

definition: cloth, clothing or apparel worn to cover the body; a dress.
example_en: They got a new dress stitched for her for the wedding.

definition: the Love-God, Kāma.
example_en: People worshipped the Love-God Kama at the temple.

definition: the way in which a person or thing appears to the eye or to the mind; outward aspect; appearance.
example_en: Everyone admired her seeing her appearance.

definition: any chemical substance used to destroy weeds or to check their growth; a weedicide; a herbicide.
example_en: The farmer sprayed herbicide on the paddy field.

definition: the state of being confused, perplexed; perplexity.
example_en: Hearing the news, he became confused and perplexed.

definition: a pleasing odour.
example_en: A pleasing odour spread from that incense stick.

definition: ancestors collectively; ancestry.
example_en: This land has come down from our ancestors.

definition: a bee that makes honey from the nectar of flowers, esp., the common hive bee (Apis mellifera).
example_en: The bee collects nectar from flowers.

definition: a disorder of the muscles of the eyes, as cross-eye, in which both eyes cannot be focused on the same point at the same time; strabismus.
example: ಮೆಳ್ಳೆಗಣ್ಣಿನ ಮಗು ವೈದ್ಯರ ಬಳಿಗೆ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The child with strabismus came to the doctor for treatment.

definition: that means.
example_en: That means tomorrow is a holiday.

definition: engagement of a man and a woman in a sexual procreation act; coplation.
example_en: There is a description of copulation in the old poem.

definition: a female child.
example_en: A female child was born to that couple.

definition: a fat woman.
example_en: The fat woman from the next house was sitting idly.

definition: an iron hammer.
example_en: The blacksmith beat the iron with an iron hammer.

definition: to have a hollow place in the stem or a branch.
example_en: The branch broken by the storm had become hollow.

definition: the act of managing; management; supervision.
example_en: The management of this institution is running well.

definition: the state or quality of being obsolete or not in currency at all; obsolescence.
example: ಆ ಪದ್ಧತಿಯ ಅಪ್ರಚಲಿತತೆ ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ.
example_en: The obsolescence of that custom remains only in books.

definition: (vīr.) to undertake a profession with dedication.
example_en: He undertook the carpenter's profession with dedication and stayed in the town.

definition: very tall; of great height.
example_en: The very tall building stands in the middle of the town.

definition: an younger sister of one's husband.
example_en: My husband's younger sister bought a sari for the wedding.

definition: a wide eye.
example: ಆ ಮಗುವಿನ ಹೆಗ್ಗಣ್ ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೆಚ್ಚಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone admired the child's wide eyes.

definition: the act of hurrying (esp. carelessly or recklessly).
example_en: In his hurry, he left his book at home.

definition: a kind of alliteration, in which two syllables repeat in different words following each other.
example: ಕವಿತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಛೇಕಾನುಪ್ರಾಸವು ಸೊಗಸಾದ ಶಬ್ದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಶಬ್ದವನ್ನು ಪುನರಾವರ್ತಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: In poetry, a kind of alliteration repeats syllable upon syllable in a pleasing way.

definition: to become angry; to be enraged, infuriated.
example_en: Hearing his words, she became angry.

definition: a large mass of stone.
example_en: A large mass of stone lay near the hill.

definition: a duct that carries tears; the lachrymal duct.
example_en: Due to excessive sorrow, her lachrymal duct had swollen.

definition: of a distinct or particular kind or character; special.
example_en: That subject demands special attention.

definition: to cut and turn up soil with a plough; to make furrows in with a plough.
example_en: The farmer ploughed the field with the oxen.

definition: an act or fact of annoying, harming another; molestation.
example_en: The villagers were tired of his harassment.

definition: a word imitating the metallic sound produced when a weapon strikes another.
example_en: When the weapon struck, it made a 'kanaku' clanging sound.

definition: a woman.
example_en: The woman capably managed the responsibilities of the house.

definition: the person who swallows; a swallower.
example_en: The swallower of the medicine recovered quickly.

definition: any holy scripture of a religion.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ಧರ್ಮಕ್ಕೂ ತನ್ನದೇ ಆದ ಧರ್ಮಗ್ರಂಥ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Every religion has its own holy scripture.

definition: the quality, condition or fact of being enslaved or addicted to a habit obsessively, esp. to a bad one as consuption of narcotic drugs.
example_en: Addiction to liquor ruined his life.

definition: a channel branching out from a main one.
example_en: This branch channel splits off from the main channel.

definition: the act of preparing food by frying or roasting.
example_en: They were frying the snacks in the kitchen.

definition: a tantric action which supposedly prohibits evil spirits, epidemics entering into a house, village etc.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಕಾಯಕಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿ ರೋಗವನ್ನು ತಡೆದರು.
example_en: The villagers performed a protective tantric rite and stopped the epidemic.

definition: feeling of resentful or discontented longing aroused by another person's better fortune, situation, etc; envy; jealousy.
example: ನೆರೆಮನೆಯವರ ಸಂಪತ್ತು ಕಂಡು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಕೇಣ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the neighbour's wealth, jealousy arose in him.

definition: the act or an instance of pressing, pushing using force.
example_en: There was a lot of pushing in the crowd.

definition: Ādiśeṣa, who has one thousand (or innumerable) hoods.
example: ಸಾಸಿರದಲೆಯ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಹೆಡೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ ಎಂದು ಪುರಾಣ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The purana says Adishesha of a thousand hoods bears the earth on his hoods.

definition: the act or fact of keeping awake and alert, in order to look after, protect or guard; a watch; a vigil.
example: ಘರವಟಿಗೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತರು.
example_en: The soldiers stood at the gate keeping vigil.

definition: the act of distilling; distillation.
example_en: The process of distillation was going on in the factory.

definition: the grass Cenchrus ciliaris of Poaceae family; bunch grass.
example_en: The farmer fed the Cenchrus ciliaris grass to the cows as fodder.

definition: lacking strength, vigour; weak.
example_en: His body became weak due to the fever.

definition: to move through water by movements of the arms and legs or of flippers, fins, tail, etc.; to swim.
example_en: The children are learning to swim in the pond.

definition: afflicted; distressed; suffering from (a calamity, danger, pain, disease, etc.).
example_en: They helped the person afflicted by the accident.

definition: the quality of a consonant, sound or voice, being nasal.
example_en: The nasality in his voice was clearly heard.

definition: to cause to dig.
example_en: The master had the well dug by the workers.

definition: the act of rejecting with disapproval or denial; repudiation.
example_en: The committee rejected that proposal with denial.

definition: a hard stalk of a potherb.
example_en: They used the fallen hard potherb stalk as fodder for the cattle.

definition: he who grins obsequiously.
example: ಆ ಹಲುದೆಱಹಿ ಒಡೆಯನ ಎದುರು ಸದಾ ನಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That obsequious grinner was always smiling before his master.

definition: facing or opposite one another.
example_en: Both of them sat facing each other and talked.

definition: a graceful movement of the eyebrows.
example_en: Her graceful movement of the eyebrows drew everyone's attention.

definition: increase of virile energy.
example: ಆ ಔಷಧಿ ವೀರ್ಯವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say that medicine helps in the increase of virile energy.

definition: a bringing forth; a causing to manifest.
example: ಗುರುವಿನ ಆಶೀರ್ವಾದ ಶಿಷ್ಯನ ಒಳಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಚೈತನ್ಯದ ಓಹರಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The guru's blessing brought forth new vigor within the disciple.

definition: a quick, short look.
example_en: She gave me a quick glance and smiled.

definition: the quality or condition of being humble; humility.
example_en: Humility was clearly visible in his speech.

definition: grasped; held; seized.
example_en: That prisoner was seized by the police.

definition: a kind of bushy plant.
example_en: A bushy plant had grown in the corner of the courtyard.

definition: to shine with a sparkling light; to be bright; to glitter.
example_en: The stars were sparkling brightly in the sky.

definition: to become excited, very active or highly aroused.
example_en: Hearing the music, the crowd became highly excited.

definition: a musalman soldier.
example_en: The Muslim soldier was guarding the gate of the fort.

definition: to reflect; to mirror.
example_en: The pond's water reflected the sky.

definition: the fact or condition of not contacting; lack of contact.
example: ಆ ಊರಿಗೆ ರಸ್ತೆಯ ನಿಃಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಇನ್ನೂ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That village still has no road contact.

definition: that which can be measured.
example_en: Distance is a quantity that can be measured.

definition: an engine using steam under pressure to supply mechanical energy, usually through the action of a piston sliding in a cylinder; a steam engine.
example_en: In olden times, the steam engine was very useful.

definition: the act or process of covering a substance (as a metal surface) with a thin coating of gold, silver, tin, etc. 2) the substance so applied.
example: ಆ ತಾಮ್ರದ ಪಾತ್ರೆಗೆ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯ ಗಿಲೀಟು ಮಾಡಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: That copper vessel was given a silver gilding coat.

definition: a kind of large insect with brown wings.
example_en: The large brown-winged insect hid under the leaf.

definition: to tie with a thread.
example_en: He tied the packet with thread and secured it.

definition: a female horse.
example_en: The rider mounted the white mare and set off.

definition: to be or become frozen.
example_en: The pond water froze in the night's cold.

definition: one of the prominent cities in Karnāṭaka, former capital of the princely state Mysūru. the erstwhile princely state of Mysūru.
example_en: Mysuru is famous for its palace.

definition: Reddish blue colour.
example: ಅವಳ ಸೀರೆಯ ಕೆನ್ನೀಲಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The reddish blue colour of her saree caught everyone's attention.

definition: a human being.
example_en: Every human being should receive respect.

definition: the fire in the kiln.
example_en: The fire in the kiln burned throughout the night.

definition: bad luck; ill fortune; trouble; adversity; misfortune; calamity.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ರಿಷ್ಟ ಬಂತು.
example_en: A great deal of misfortune befell that family this year.

definition: to become shiny or more shiny.
example_en: The silver vessel became shinier when it was polished.

definition: a huge boulder that is in its natural position and shape.
example: ಆ ಹೊಲದ ನಡುವೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹುಟ್ಟರೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a large natural boulder in the middle of that field.

definition: a battle or combat.
example_en: That battle is very famous in the epic.

definition: (humourously, sarc. or derog.) to eat.
example_en: He gobbles down ten dosas at a meal.

definition: great plenty; abundance.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಳೆಯ ನಿಕಾಮ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದಾಯಿತು.
example_en: This year, the abundance of rain was good for the crop.

definition: wearing apparel (as shoes or boots) for the feet; footwear.
example_en: Good footwear is needed in winter.

definition: a blow given in return; a counter-blow.
example_en: He gave a counter-blow to the strike.

definition: any one of numerous annelid worms that burrow in soil and feed on soil nutrients and decaying organic matter; an earthworm.
example_en: The earthworm is hidden in the soil.

definition: a daughter of one's son or daughter.
example_en: The granddaughter came home for the holidays.

definition: a small gate in a hedge or an enclosure-wall, just to allow a person to enter in; a wicket-gate.
example: ತೋಟದ ಬೇಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಡಕಲನ್ನು ತೆರೆದು ಅವನು ಒಳಗೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: He opened the wicket-gate in the garden hedge and came inside.

definition: a person who tends grazing cattle; a cowherd.
example_en: That cowherd grazes the cattle right from morning.

definition: the ejection of one or more electrons from a substance, usu. a metal, when subjected to light or other suitable radiation; photo-emission.
example: ಈ ಸಾಧನ ದ್ಯುತಿ ಉತ್ಸರ್ಜನೆಯ ತತ್ವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This device works on the principle of photo-emission.

definition: to push (with force); to impel.
example_en: He impelled the cart forward with force.

definition: the tree Morinda citrifolia of Rubiaceae family; turmeric timber tree.
example: ಆ ನೋಣಿ ಮರದ ಬೇರುಗಳಿಂದ ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣ ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They prepare a yellow dye from the roots of that noni tree.

definition: The birthday Prophet, a Muslim festival.
example: ಮುಸ್ಲಿಮರು ಈದ್ ಮಿಲಾದ್ ಹಬ್ಬವನ್ನು ಸಂಭ್ರಮದಿಂದ ಆಚರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Muslims celebrated the festival of Id Milad with great joy.

definition: (pl.) two ways of manners.
example_en: There is confusion because of the two ways of thought on this matter.

definition: in a clean, neat manner; cleanly; neatly.
example_en: She cleaned the house neatly.

definition: an assembly of people for religious worship or teaching; a religious congregation.
example_en: The teacher taught Vedanta in the religious congregation.

definition: a pair of eye glasses fixed in a frame used to correct faulty vision; spectacles.
example_en: Grandfather wears spectacles to read.

definition: gone far; moved away.
example_en: Many years have passed since he moved far away from the village.

definition: radiant or luminous brightness; brilliance; lustre.
example_en: The moon's radiance lit up the night sky.

definition: the bird Turdus ginginianus.
example_en: The call of the Turdus ginginianus bird was very sweet.

definition: the tree Cinnamomum perottetii of Lauraceae family.
example_en: A hill-cinnamon tree was found at the foot of the hill.

definition: tiredness, fatigue caused by travelling.
example_en: The long journey caused her fatigue from travelling.

definition: the act of abandoning completely and forever.
example: ಅವನು ಸಂಸಾರವನ್ನೇ ವ್ಯತಿಪಾತ ಮಾಡಿ ಕಾಡಿಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He completely abandoned his family and went to the forest.

definition: that which is very heavy.
example_en: That sack was very heavy and hard to lift.

definition: the feeling of being different.
example_en: In the new town, he was troubled by a feeling of being different.

definition: the fact or an instance of (something) hanging, dangling.
example_en: The children stood watching the dangling of the rope.

definition: a shrill, high-pitched, screaming sound.
example_en: A shrill, screaming sound was heard from inside the house.

definition: a draughting ox.
example_en: The farmer yoked the draughting ox to the cart.

definition: a forest in a highland.
example_en: The sages performed penance in the highland forest.

definition: a young person, who is being taught under the supervision of a teacher or tutor, as in school; a pupil.
example_en: The teacher taught the lesson to the pupil.

definition: lack of certainty; the quality or condition of being uncertain; uncertainty.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊಗುಂ ಇತ್ತು, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: There was uncertainty in his words; there was no clarity.

definition: pure silver.
example_en: The goldsmith made an ornament out of pure silver.

definition: not tending to be attached; not sticking together; not coherent.
example_en: This powder remained incoherent, not sticking together, in the water.

definition: to provoke or enrage with stinging, pungent a remark.
example_en: Her harsh words provoked me with a stinging remark.

definition: a female swan.
example_en: The female swan was flapping its wings in the lake.

definition: to be connected with, related to.
example_en: This matter is connected to that incident.

definition: a debt that cannot be recovered; a bad-debt.
example_en: That loan has remained a bad debt for years.

definition: a royal symbol, emblem or insignia.
example_en: The crown was the king's royal insignia.

definition: that which crawls on the ground (as a worm).
example_en: After the rain, the crawling creature came out of the soil.

definition: to talk to another in a very low voice, as not to be heard by a third person; to whisper.
example_en: She whispered the secret in my ear.

definition: the quality or fact of being talkative; talkativeness.
example_en: Everyone got tired of her talkativeness.

definition: a flat, coarse fabric made of woven or plaited hemp, straw, long blades of grass Desmostachya bipinnata, etc.
example_en: He sat on a mat of woven grass for worship.

definition: he who teaches, esp. whose occupation is to instruct; a teacher; a professional instructor.
example_en: The teacher (ovaja) gives a new lesson every day.

definition: to be got, obtained (by).
example_en: A good result was obtained through effort.

definition: the quality or tendency of forgetting; poor memory; forgetfulness.
example_en: As he grew old, his forgetfulness increased.

definition: a beautiful petal (of a flower).
example_en: The beautiful petal fell gently in the breeze.

definition: to join the threads passing through warp & woofs.
example_en: The weaver joined the threads of the warp and woof.

definition: a portion or division of a garden or farm land.
example_en: The farmer planted bananas in one plot of the field.

definition: intense enthusiasm.
example_en: Intense enthusiasm was clearly visible among the students.

definition: said; uttered; mentioned.
example_en: The meeting started at the stated time.

definition: to unite two things by or as by welding.
example_en: The craftsman welded two pieces of metal together.

definition: extraordinary valour, courage.
example: ಆ ಯೋಧನ ಕಟ್ಟಾಯವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಬೆರಗಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was astonished seeing that warrior's extraordinary valour.

definition: a stack of straw, hay etc.
example_en: That stack of straw was enough to last the whole winter.

definition: a style that is beautiful.
example: ಆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಮೋಡಾಮೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The beautiful style of that saree attracted everyone's attention.

definition: an artificial channel or passage for water, having a gate or valve to regulate the flow; a sluice.
example: ರೈತರು ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರು ಹರಿಸಲು ಮರವೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: The farmers built a sluice to channel water into the field.

definition: to let (someone or something) go.
example_en: The hunter let the bird go.

definition: to put out (a fire, burning lamp, etc.); to quench; to extinguish.
example_en: The wind blew and extinguished the lamp.

definition: a mending of uneven ridges at the border of a form land.
example_en: The farmers mended the uneven ridges at the border of the field.

definition: a hard, bivalve outer covering, as of mollusc, insect, egg, etc.; a shell.
example_en: Colourful shells were found on the seashore.

definition: the under-shrub Plumbago zeylanica of Plumbaginaceae family; Ceylon lead wort.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಚರ್ಮರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಪಾಠಿ ಗಿಡದ ಬೇರನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: The physician used the root of the pathi plant for the skin disease.

definition: a lunar day (approx. equal to 0.9843 solar day).
example: ಒಂದು ತಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುಮಾರು ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕು ಗಂಟೆಗಳು ಇರುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: One lunar day consists of about twenty-four hours.

definition: that which is made in imitation so as to be passed off fraudulently or deceptively as genuine; a forged, spurious material.
example_en: The shopkeeper was selling spurious goods.

definition: a painter who earns his iving by painting.
example: ಆ ರಂಗಿಗ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಗೋಡೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಿತ್ರ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That professional painter painted pictures on the temple walls.

definition: to tie or catch with a noose.
example_en: The hunter caught the rabbit with a noose.

definition: an artificial barrier made of earth.
example: ಪ್ರವಾಹ ತಡೆಯಲು ಹೊಳೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಹೆಬ್ಬದು ಕಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: They built an earthen barrier near the river to stop the flood.

definition: a projection from a fortification; a bastion.
example_en: This bastion was a part of the old fort.

definition: day and night.
example_en: The farmers were guarding the crop day and night.

definition: a pungent smell.
example_en: A pungent smell was coming from the rotten fish.
